# NDN Collective

> Indigenous-led organization building power through philanthropy, activism, and narrative change for social justice and Indigenous sovereignty.

NDN Collective is an Indigenous-led organization dedicated to advancing Indigenous rights, power-building, and social justice through grantmaking, organizing, and strategic narrative change. The organization focuses on key issues including landback movements, the Indigenous Green New Deal, and reproductive justice.

## Key Topics

- NDN Collective
- Indigenous-led organization
- Indigenous power-building

- Mother Earth

- Roe v. Wade
